title: AI YC interview with Gstack agents : AI specialists that join your Google Meet and gives feedback | Product Hunt
excerpt: Garry Tan's open-sourced gstack specialists — CEO, CSO, QA Lead, a YC-office-hours partner and 15 more — join your real Google Meet as voice bots with 3D avatars. They open in-persona, take turns, critique your shared screen out loud, and drop notes in chat. Free, MIT, and the brain is your own coding-agent session. Built on AgentCall.
